Description
Introducing one of Dubai's premier Grade A office buildings, a magnificent 27-storey structure nestled between Dubai Marina and Dubai Media City. This iconic establishment boasts unparalleled quality. With 12 high-speed elevators serving tenants, along with three basement levels, a ground floor, and seven parking levels, convenience is assured.

Unit Details:

Available Size:  25,315 sq. ft
Base Rent: AED 230 per sq. ft per annum - rate to be finalized
Service Charge: AED 40 per sq. ft per annum
Utilities: Included in Service Charge – DEWA & Chiller (A/C) Charges
Security Deposit: 15% of Year 1 Gross Annual Rent
Condition: Fitted with Partitions
Minimum Lease Term: 5 Years
License Required: DED License
Additional Parking Cost: AED 7,000 per space per annum

Building Features:

Grade A highly efficient fully fitted office space
Move in with ZERO capex fit-out costs
Tram stop within walking distance
Building amenities include: Staff Cafeteria and Coffee Shop
Recognized as one of the Highest Quality Corporate Grade A office buildings in TECOM

PLEASE NOTE: All rents quoted are exclusive of VAT and Service Charge

Knight Frank, the leading independent global residential and commercial property consultancy headquartered in London, extends its presence in the Middle East with offices in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and Saudi Arabia. Elevate your business standards with Knight Frank.

p147336271.desc:
CBRE is pleased to present this 25,315 sq. ft. fitted open plan unit located in Landmark Tower - a LEED Gold-certified commercial tower in Dubai Marina comprising of 27 floors and is home to top international corporations and offers stunning 360° views of Dubai’s skyline, including Palm Jumeirah and Sheikh Zayed Road.

With 12 dedicated smart elevators and 2 service elevators built with a deep focus on security and privacy, providing seamless office entry with carefully controlled access to the workspace and networks. The building has 7-floors of dedicated parking that can accommodate 1,300 cars and has various amenities including a coffee shop, multi-cuisine F and B options, a gym and a supermarket.

Unit features:

- Size: 25,315 sq. ft.
- Annual rent: AED 230 per sq. ft. per annum
- Service charge: AED 40 per sq. ft. per annum (DEWA & Chiller included)
- Floor to ceiling windows
- Amazing views of Sheikh Zayed Road
- Good ceiling height
- Plenty of natural light
- Efficient floor plates
- DED license required
- 1/650 sq. ft. parking ratio 
- Prime location within Dubai Marina

Building features:

- LEED Gold certified tower
- Access to food and beverage outlets
- Ample visitor parking
- Security and concierge services in place
- Secure barrier entry system
- Tram stop within walking distance

The Landmark Tower is located in the vibrant Dubai Marina district, offering direct access to major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and Al Marsa Street, making commuting across Dubai convenient. It is also connected to key routes such as King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud Street and Al Khayay Street, ensuring smooth access to surrounding areas like JBR, Palm Jumeirah, and Media City. The tower’s prime waterfront setting places it within walking distance of Dubai Marina Mall, Marina Walk, and the beach, combining accessibility with lifestyle convenience.
